query:
SELECT m.sponsorId, s.companyName, COUNT(*) as meetingCount
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
GROUP BY m.sponsorId, s.companyName
ORDER BY m.sponsorId;
